plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add photo filters and other features to Paloma. Switch a plugin on or off at any time.
plugins.externalWarning: External plugins run with full access to this computer. Switch on only plugins you trust.
plugins.installHint: To install a plugin, copy or clone its folder into the plugins folder and restart Paloma.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings are remembered in this browser only.
settings.languageHint: The language of every text in Paloma.
settings.levelHint: How many tools Paloma shows. Choose a lower level for a beginner or a child.
settings.navBarHint: Close, previous and next photo, and zoom.
settings.editBarHint: Undo, redo and the photo fixes, such as crop and rotate.
settings.skinHint: How the screen is built: where the menus are, and how large text and buttons are.
settings.themeHint: Colors only. The layout stays the same.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The original layout with large, labelled buttons.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: More photos on the screen: smaller text and thumbnails, icon buttons, a sidebar you can fold away.

glass.name: Fluid Glass
glass.description: For tablets and touch: photos fill the screen under floating, see-through bars, with large buttons.

system.name: System
system.description: Follows your computer: dark or high contrast when it is set that way.

light.name: Light
light.description: Dark text on a light background.

dark.name: Dark
dark.description: Light text on a dark background, easy on the eyes in a dim room.

high-contrast.name: High Contrast
high-contrast.description: White and bright colors on black, for the clearest text.

child.name: Child
child.description: Only albums and slideshows; nothing can be changed. Settings need a PIN. This keeps children from changing things by accident, but it is not a security lock.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Albums, folders, search, stars, simple fixes, export and print.

normal.name: Normal
normal.description: Every tool: people, map, collage, movies, plugins and all photo fixes.

pro.name: Professional
pro.description: Everything in Normal, and tools for experienced users as they are added.

developer.name: Developer
developer.description: Everything Paloma and its plugins offer, including tools for developers.

pin.unlockHint: Settings are locked. Enter the PIN to open them.
pin.createHint: Choose a PIN of 4 to 8 digits. It will be needed to open Settings.
pin.invalid: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
pin.mismatch: The PINs differ. Please start again.
pin.wait: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{time}}.
